technical_hypothesis.primary_training_data_risk: normal vegetation varies by species, season, weather, terrain, capture geometry, municipal work, and network configuration, so an unsupervised model can treat legitimate change as hazardous and miss locally abnormal clearance conditions

training_data.observation_unit: one georeferenced network span or inspection capture at the review decision point
training_data.input_data: imagery or LiDAR available before field dispatch, asset geometry, conductor clearance rules, vegetation class when known, weather and season, prior inspections, and recent pruning records
training_data.target_or_reward: human-confirmed encroachment, required intervention class, or verified no-action result
training_data.label_source: field inspection, georeferenced pruning completion, and engineer review corrections; consistency is unknown
training_data.prediction_time: after remote inspection capture and before field verification or pruning prioritization
training_data.expected_volume: unknown and utility-specific; sufficient longitudinal and geographic coverage must be measured before training
training_data.class_balance: unknown; materially dangerous encroachment is expected to be less common than normal vegetation but must not be assumed
training_data.historical_coverage: unknown; likely fragmented across GIS, inspection vendors, imagery stores, work orders, and municipal coordination records
training_data.train_validation_split: geographic, seasonal, and time-based holdouts across municipalities, vegetation types, sensors, and network classes
training_data.leakage_risks: completed pruning, outage cause confirmed after the decision, revised risk category, field inspection result, and post-event imagery
training_data.representativeness_risks: species, growth rates, urban density, terrain, climate, sensor altitude, image resolution, LiDAR density, and local pruning practices
training_data.feedback_loop: prioritized spans receive more inspection and better labels, which can bias future training toward already-visible risk areas
training_data.privacy_and_usage_constraints: minimize incidental capture of people and private property; preserve environmental, municipal, safety, and engineering authorization requirements
training_data.fallback_if_data_is_insufficient: regulatory vegetation-management plan, periodic inspections, deterministic clearance measurements, GIS risk layers, seasonal rules, and engineer-defined prioritization

portfolio_comparison.reason: Vegetation anomaly detection is a mature condition-monitoring and inspection-prioritization pattern. ENERGY-002 already consumes vegetation as an outage-restoration signal, while current commercial inspection platforms provide georeferenced vegetation encroachment, clearance analysis, change detection, and GIS/EAM integration. The sector-specific configuration does not establish a distinct repository opportunity.

existing_landscape.summary: Adopt or integrate established geospatial and power-line inspection capabilities, combining deterministic clearance rules, regulatory vegetation plans, GIS, LiDAR or photogrammetry, and human field verification rather than creating a separate generic anomaly solution.

research.findings: Brazilian regulation now requires operational vegetation-management plans with prioritized areas, monitoring, preventive and corrective actions. Recent Brazilian evidence confirms vegetation remains a major interruption driver and shows active drone and multimodal inspection research. Current commercial platforms already provide AI-assisted defect and vegetation encroachment detection, 3D clearance analysis, change tracking, and GIS/EAM integration, leaving no materially differentiated opportunity.

where_ai_enters.primary_mechanism: geospatial or point-cloud anomaly detection for vegetation encroachment and abnormal clearance conditions
where_ai_enters.human_control: engineers and vegetation-management teams retain inspection confirmation, environmental and municipal coordination, pruning authorization, safety decisions, and work acceptance
